Backend findings and design recommendation follow. All paths below are relative to `/Users/jamie/development/exposed`. This was read-only.

- Rankings support only the current term. The HTTP handler accepts no query, the service creates `CurrentParliamentStart`, and the repository applies `registration_date >= start`. See `exposed/src/lib/inbound/http/handlers/rankings.rs:84`, `exposed/src/lib/domain/services/rankings.rs:51`, and `exposed/src/lib/outbound/rankings.rs:41`.
- MP and funder detail requests currently contain only an entity ID. Both services read complete history and resolve this year with `Utc::now()`. See `exposed/src/lib/domain/models/entity_details.rs:35`, `exposed/src/lib/domain/models/entity_details.rs:60`, and `exposed/src/lib/domain/services/entity_details.rs:36`.
- Detail responses already provide authoritative historical, current-term, and current-year GBP totals. `DeclaredTotalsAggregate` calculates all three using shared `PeriodAggregate`. See `exposed/src/lib/domain/services/entity_details.rs:59` and `exposed/src/lib/inbound/http/handlers/entity_details.rs:192`.
- Other detail data remains historical. MP declaration lists, currency totals, counts, and coverage metadata use all history. Funder currency breakdowns, party allocations, top ten recipients, and entry counts also use all history. See `exposed/src/lib/domain/services/entity_details.rs:99`, `exposed/src/lib/domain/services/entity_details.rs:143`, and `exposed/src/lib/domain/services/entity_details.rs:228`.

Recommend one Rust domain enum, `ReportingPeriod::{Historical,CurrentTerm,CurrentYear}`, parsed from one shared query vocabulary, for example `period=historical|current-term|current-year`. Resolve it once per request into a typed registration window with explicit UTC boundaries and undated-record behavior. The domain service should own resolution; repositories should receive the resolved window. HTTP and SvelteKit should serialize and relay it rather than reproduce date rules.

Return resolved period metadata with selected-period data, for example `period`, `startInclusive`, `endExclusive`, and `includesUndated`. Preserve the existing mandatory `declared_totals` object for MP and funder details. Add a clearly scoped selected-period view containing declarations, declaration and entry counts, currency breakdowns, category breakdowns, and recipient/party allocations. Derive every selected-period output from the same selected declaration stream. This avoids showing a current-year headline above historical allocations.

Important semantics and edge cases:

- Term inclusion is already July 9, 2024 at midnight UTC, inclusive. Undated declarations are historical only. See `exposed/src/lib/domain/models/declared_totals.rs:91`.
- This year already means the complete UTC calendar year, using year equality. A resolved half-open window should preserve this behavior, including any future-dated records within that year. Do not quietly change it to year-to-date. See `exposed/src/lib/domain/models/entity_details.rs:222`.
- Historical should mean all stored records, including current-term records and undated records, rather than “before this term.”
- Preserve exact `BigDecimal` aggregation and string serialization. Missing GBP amounts and unknown currencies cause incompleteness; known foreign currencies are excluded without making GBP totals incomplete. Null totals remain distinct from zero. See `exposed/src/lib/domain/models/declared_totals.rs:8`, `exposed/src/lib/domain/models/declared_totals.rs:71`, and `exposed/src/lib/inbound/http/handlers/entity_details.rs:173`.
- Declaration counts include declarations without entries; entry counts preserve every occurrence. Do not count join rows or deduplicate identical entries. See `exposed/src/lib/domain/models/declared_totals.rs:30` and `exposed/src/lib/outbound/entity_details.rs:41`.
- Rankings have deliberate category scope differences. MP rankings include every category; individual, company, and party boards include only donation/support declarations. Funder detail totals currently include all associated categories. A consistent period selector must preserve this difference, so a ranked funder’s total can still differ from its detail headline. See `exposed/src/lib/domain/services/rankings.rs:68` and `exposed/src/lib/outbound/entity_details.rs:218`.
- Rankings sort globally before taking ten. Historical/year support must filter source declarations before aggregation and sorting, never filter the current ten displayed rows. See `exposed/src/lib/domain/services/rankings.rs:28`.
- Funder identity resolution already expands alias-group members and restricts funding entries to that group. Filter declarations without expanding to other funders’ entries in a shared declaration. See `exposed/src/lib/outbound/entity_details.rs:100` and `exposed/src/lib/outbound/entity_details.rs:213`.
- Current party metadata is latest stored affiliation, including in historical party allocations. A new period filter does not establish historical affiliation. See `exposed/src/lib/domain/models/entity_details.rs:83` and `exposed/src/lib/domain/services/entity_details.rs:185`.
- Empty filtered results should preserve entity identity and return empty selected data, rather than 404.
- Capture one clock instant for the request and return the resolved year. Cache keys for `current-year` must account for UTC year rollover.

No files were edited.
